title: E-Consent Is a Disclosure Delivery Control, Not a Checkbox: What the E-Sign Act Requires Before an AI Agent Sends a Loan Estimate Electronically
summary: If a borrower never gave valid E-Sign consent, the Loan Estimate you emailed was never delivered, and the TRID clock you thought you satisfied is still running. The E-Sign Act asks for more than a clicked box: it asks the borrower to reasonably demonstrate they can open the format you will actually use. How an AI point-of-sale agent captures that consent correctly, and what breaks when it treats consent as a formality.
